description: Returns the reading records the HTMLRadar website exports as a spreadsheet, as CSV text: one row per section per read, with the link's label and address, the reader, whether their address was verified, when they opened it, how long they read, how far they scrolled, and their country and device where recorded. The sender's own previews and internal viewers are left out, as on the website. Pass `share_id` for one link; without it every link of the document is included. A very long answer is cut at a whole record and gives a `continue_from` value: call again with the same arguments and that value for the next rows, until it says it is every row. For a quick answer about who read one link, get_share_activity is shorter. It changes nothing.

continue_from.description: The `continue_from` value a previous answer gave, to read the rows after it. Omit it to start from the first row.

document_id.description: The document — the document id from list_documents or list_shares.

share_id.description: Limit the records to one link: the share id, the share's slug, or the link itself.

name: get_reading_records
title: Get a document's reading records
